name: Vanderbilt Epilepsy MRI + BIEN-lab SEEG/fMRI derivatives

repo.accession: MRI 10.26275/e22w-ksut; peri-ictal PDC 10.26275/n0bo-jg77; SOZ RS-SEEG 10.26275/wtaz-dbst; NBM fMRI 10.26275/wpvi-2p72

cohort.types: TLE (MRI set); drug-resistant epilepsy with SEEG (75–78 patients)

modalities: MRI set: anatomic, functional and diffusion 3T, many with post-op scans. SEEG sets: per-seizure PDC and imaginary coherence (75 patients, 668 seizures); interictal SEEG for SOZ classification (78 patients); parcellated fMRI (75 pre-op, 34 post-op, 106 controls)
format: MRI: BIDS-like sub-*/ses-* folders + demographic and scan-info CSVs; SEEG sets are mostly derived matrices + code
size: MRI 52.9 GB; PDC 894.6 GB; SOZ SEEG 11.8 GB; NBM fMRI 0.1 GB
labels: SEEG sets: SOZ / propagation zone / non-involved zone labels (per papers)
outcomes: Not confirmed in the files opened
caveats: Mostly derived features, not raw SEEG
checks: Pennsieve readmes and top-level trees for all four; abstracts of Makhoul 2025 and Sundrani 2025.
pipeline: Propagation benchmark: peri-ictal directed connectivity by SOZ / PZ / NIZ across 668 seizures is a ready target for the recruitment metric R1 recommended.
key_claim: Large single-centre TLE MRI (89 pts incl. DWI) plus derived peri-ictal SEEG connectivity for 668 seizures; non-commercial.

evidence.quote: This database includes anatomic, functional and diffusion 3T MRI images for 89 patients with temporal lobe epilepsy between the ages of 18 and 68 yrs.
We computed directed connectivity from 5 s windows in the periods between, immediately before, during and after 668 seizures.
